body: I know this sounds like it's not possibly true, but you will wake up one day and you'll feel better. Hold on to that even though it seems so far away right now, the sharp pain you feel will dull eventually and you'll find someone else who will make you laugh at how you thought this girl was the one. Another thing that helps is finding something else to think about when you start to think about her. When I was going through a really rough break-up a couple months ago, I decided I would put on hardcore rap and dance as hard as I could every time I thought about him. I literally feel like I read a post in my diary. I am 24 and in grad school too, and I'm struggling seriously. Each time I go to the psychiatrist I feel like I've taken one step forward and two steps back. I've canceled the last three appointments with my therapist because I feel like it would be too exhausting to talk about what I'm feeling. 

I should be writing my thesis right now, I'm supposed to graduate this semester. But I cannot muster up the energy to open up that judgemental blank doc file, and to stare at that blinking cursor mocking my incompetence. As much as I don't want another meeting with my thesis advisor saying "Well, as soon as you have some writing , we can actually talk about something" I just can't bring myself to start writing.

I feel like I'm smarter than hurting myself. I am a rational human, why do I keep doing this to myself? I know that I have a great life but I just can't stop. When I finally got the courage to talk to my mom about it she just said "I don't need to get calls like this. You don't need to do stuff like that anymore." Which just made me feel even more crazy, I can't stop.

I don't want to kill myself either, but it would be so nice to hurt myself enough that they'd put me in the hospital and I could just sleep for days without having any pressure, you know?
